entries.title: Nine styles of ambient music to choose from
entries.body: Pick how the ambient music sounds with the new Style choice in Settings → Appearance, or ask your first mate. Star cruise, a soft pattern echoing over a slow pulse, now plays by default. The other eight take you through deep space, a pirate cove, a harbor at dawn and a Pacific island, and the sea styles carry soft waves under the music. Every style still follows your crew, chimes when something waits for you and sparkles when a task merges.

picture.alt: The Sound group in Settings → Appearance, with Ambient music on, the new Style choice on Star cruise, and Volume at 40%
